question: When was aluminium a luxury metal?
answer: In the 1850s. It is one of the commonest elements in the crust but was brutally hard to separate, so it cost more than gold — Napoleon III is said to have reserved aluminium cutlery for his most important guests. A new electrolytic process collapsed the price within about a decade.
move: Aluminium went from imperial cutlery to disposable foil in one lifetime.
